# Pilot Institute

> > Comprehensive online aviation training platform offering FAA-certified courses for drone and airplane pilots, from recreational TRUST certification to commercial pilot licenses.

Pilot Institute provides structured, exam-focused ground school courses for aspiring pilots seeking FAA certifications. The platform specializes in Part 107 drone licensing, Private Pilot training, and recreational UAS safety education, with lifetime course access and money-back guarantees.

## Key Topics

- Part 107 (Commercial Drone License)
- Private Pilot Certification
- FAA Exam Preparation
- Part 61 Ground School
- TRUST Certificate (Recreational Drones)
- FAA Regulations & Airspace Rules
- Drone Business & Entrepreneurship
- Commercial Pilot Training
- Aviation Education
- Online Courses with Lifetime Access
- Money-Back Guarantee
- Drone Registration & Compliance
- LAANC (Low Altitude Authorization)
- FAA Drone Zone
- Recreational UAS Safety Test

## Core Training Courses

- [Part 107 Commercial Drone Pilot License Course](https://pilotinstitute.com/course/part-107-remote-pilot): 15-hour Part 107 drone license course with practice exams and lifetime access
- [Private Pilot Ground School: Ace the FAA Exam](https://pilotinstitute.com/course/part-61-private-pilot): 35-hour Part 61 Private Pilot ground school with FAA exam preparation
- [Drone Courses - Free and Paid Drone Pilot Training](https://pilotinstitute.com/courses/drones): Drone pilot training courses including Part 107 certification and commercial license prep
- [Airplane Pilot Training School - Online Aviation Courses](https://pilotinstitute.com/courses/airplanes): Aviation training for Private Pilot, Instrument Rating, and Commercial Pilot certifications

## Regulatory Guidance & Certification

- [FAA TRUST Online Portal for Recreational Drone Operators](https://trust.pilotinstitute.com): FAA TRUST Certificate portal for recreational drone operators and UAS safety testing
- [Federal Drone Laws in the United States (FAA)](https://pilotinstitute.com/drones): Guide to FAA drone regulations including Part 107, TRUST, and airspace rules
- [How Much Does It Cost to Become a Pilot?](https://pilotinstitute.com/pilot-license-cost): Guide to pilot license costs including Private, Commercial, and ATP certifications
